description: This header file declares interfaces for integrating and interacting with an 'angel' component within the lighttpd server project. It includes function prototypes for setting up the angel, listening on sockets, logging messages, and internal fake implementations.

methods.name: li_angel_setup
methods.description: Initializes the angel integration with the server.

methods.name: li_angel_listen
methods.description: Sets up listening on a socket with a callback for events.

methods.name: li_angel_log
methods.description: Send log messages during startup to the angel, and frees the message string.

methods.name: li_angel_log_open_file
methods.description: Opens a log file for the angel and sets up internal logging.
